name: Muiriath
text: Muiriath, also spelled Moriath, is the daughter of Scoriath in the tale of the Destruction of Dind Rig. She marries Labraid Loingsech and settles beside him in his realm of Leinster.

attributes.attribute: daughter of Scoriath in Orgain Denna Rig
